name: AI Race adapter
summary: Speaks the race protocol (ASRP/1) so the AI Race verifier can test your agent (python -m agent race to try a task). You write the AI logic for each task type.

env.note: From your team page on Agent Studio. Only the race verifier sends it.
Name shown in the health response.
For the Memory layer on serverless hosting: keeps conversation history between requests. Free Upstash Redis database; Vercel's Upstash integration sets KV_REST_API_URL instead, which also works.
The REST token for that database (or KV_REST_API_TOKEN from Vercel's integration).

prerequisites: A team on Agent Studio (for the verifier token)
A public https:// URL when you race (deploy, or a tunnel such as ngrok)
